### Summary

The scripts in `examples/` are the quick-start runs of the overview chapter (@sec-ch01). They cover Earth and
Jupiter thermodynamics, a Jupiter adiabat, the Chapman cycle, chemical equilibrium with NASA polynomials, sodium
sulfide evaporation and two steady solutions of the two-dimensional solver. No `ctest` entry runs them, so nothing in
the suite checks that they still work. This section records one run of every script at the pin: seven finish, and
two stop with an error because they call the Python interface in a way the bindings do not accept.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Whether each example script runs at the pin.

**Data.** Exit status and last output line of each script, on the CPU build.

**Placement.** By hand, after installing kintera; not part of `ctest`.

**Activation.** `python <script>` in `examples/`.

**Guarantee / limits.** 7 of 9 run; the Chapman-cycle and dry-Earth examples fail.

**Evidence.** See the Tests layer below.
:::

### Derivation

No derivation: this scheme records whether scripts run. Their physics is derived in the chapters they illustrate.

### Numerical method

No numerical method. Each script was run once with the CPU build, no GPU visible and a non-interactive plotting
backend, from a copy of `examples/`. A run counts as passing when the script exits with status 0. The file
`examples/test_type_hints.py` is a type-hint demonstration that skips itself when imported, so it is not counted.

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| none (by hand) | each example exits with status 0 | exact | the exit status |

: Example runs at the pin. {#tbl-ch13-examples-tests}

Seven scripts exit with status 0: `example_earth.py`, `example_jupiter.py`, `example_jupiter_adiabat.py`,
`example_na2s_evaporation.py`, `equilibrium_nasa9.py`, `plot_atm2d_steady_advection_diffusion.py` and
`plot_atm2d_steady_diffusion_dirichlet_2d.py`. `example_jupiter.py` exits 0 but prints
`equilibrate_tp did not converge after 15 iterations.` along the way. Two scripts fail:[^ch13-examples-run]

- `example_chapman_cycle.py` stops in `run_chapman_cycle`
  ({{< code examples/example_chapman_cycle.py run_chapman_cycle >}}) with `TypeError: forward(): incompatible
  function arguments`. It calls `arrhenius.forward(temp, pres, conc)` with three arguments, while the binding of
  `Arrhenius.forward` ({{< code python/csrc/pykinetics.cpp >}}) requires a fourth, the mapping `other`, with no
  default.
- `example_earth_dry.py` ({{< code examples/example_earth_dry.py >}}) stops with
  `AttributeError: 'ThermoX' object has no attribute 'extrapolate_ad'`. The bindings
  ({{< code python/csrc/pythermo.cpp >}}) expose `extrapolate_dlnp` and `extrapolate_dz` on `ThermoX`, while the type
  stub {{< code python/kintera.pyi >}} still declares `extrapolate_ad`.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
- **Two quick-start examples fail at the pin**, as listed above, and the suite does not notice: no `ctest` entry
  runs `examples/`. Registering each example as a `ctest` entry would catch such breakage.
:::

- The examples were run once, on CPU only, and only their exit status is checked; their printed numbers are not
  compared with any reference.
